title: Field Signal Annotary — Priority Lanes (Sep 2026)
summary: Loose synthesis of customer-facing signals collected Aug–Sep 2026 across Support, Solutions, and CSM calls. Purpose: produce a lightweight, actionable lane map for product and eng to triage quick wins vs. medium scope vs. longer bets.
synth_notes: Data sources: support tickets (priority buckets), Solutions onboarding notes, three post-demo interviews (RetailCorp, LegalBank, EduAI), two SRE incident writeups referencing model fallback behavior.

Tone: many asks are operational (observability, debugging IDs, traceability) rather than purely feature UI. Customers want clearer failure modes and predictable fallbacks more than new generation fanciness.
Recurring friction: unclear when hosted -> dedicated transition recommended; teams hit unpredictable cost spikes during burst traffic (esp. embeddings-heavy workloads).
Embedding drift is a growing theme: customers notice search relevance regressions over months and want automated drift detection + reindex triggers.
Several customers (esp. regulated finance) ask for explicit "fallback-to-small-model" control with SLA-preserving latency—prefer declarative routing knobs, not manual workarounds.
A few engineering teams requested better prefix/KV cache visibility (TTL, hit rates per route) to validate cost optimization experiments.
Multiple asks for curated model profiles: customers prefer a recommended default config for 'low-latency chat', 'cheap-embeddings', 'throughput-batch-inference' to avoid trial-and-error.
Some requests are more about onboarding docs: clear checklist for migrating from hosted to Dedicated with estimated wait times and capacity planning examples.
feature_requests: Explicit fallback policy UI: allow route-level specification: primary model, fallback variant, and max-fallback-latency (S).
KV cache telemetry endpoints: per-route hit/miss counters, TTL histogram, and sample-keys for debugging (M).
Embedding drift monitor: automated daily sampling, delta metric + alert threshold, auto-suggest reindex cadence and candidate small-scale re-index job (L).
Burst-capacity preview: show 24h/7d historical peak estimates and recommended burst buffer size with cost estimate (M).
Onboarding checklist: 'hosted->dedicated' migration playbook with sample Linear/Jira templates and an expected timeline card (quick-win).
Model profile library: curated presets (low-latency, low-cost, high-quality) including kernel/quantization recommendations and billing impact (S).
Route-level trace-id in console: clickable link to raw trace with token-level latency waterfall for sampled requests (M).
API parameter: prefer_small_model=true to auto-route to cost-efficient variant during high-cost windows (S).
Console alert templates for regressions tied to eval prompt sets (M).
Quota-symmetric routing: throttling policy that preserves fairness across customer routes during capacity pressure (L).
priority_rationale: S (quick-win): low engineering lift, high immediate customer satisfaction. Examples: onboarding checklist, model profile presets, prefer_small_model flag.
M (medium): needs telemetry plumbing and UI work but directly addresses repeated pain (KV cache telemetry, route trace links, burst preview).
L (longer-bet): algorithmic and infra changes, cross-team ownership (embedding drift auto-detection, quota-symmetric routing).
quick_wins: Publish 'hosted->dedicated' migration checklist in Console (docs + UI card). Owner: Solutions; ETA: 2 weeks.
Add three model profile presets in the product catalog with sample billing impact. Owner: Product-hosted-api; ETA: 1 sprint.
Expose a simple boolean API flag (prefer_small_model) that routes to compatible cheaper variants if available. Owner: Serving-runtime; ETA: 2 sprints.
Customer communication: send proactive note to top 12 customers with cost spike playbook and contact for SRE if they want a dedicated slot. Owner: CSM; ETA: 1 week.
medium_scope: KV cache telemetry: instrumented metrics + Console UI panels. Dependencies: infra metrics routing, minimal schema design. Owner: Observability + Serving. Est effort: 3 sprints.
Route-level trace link: sample request traces surfaced in Console with token waterfall. Dependencies: tracing backend, sampling policy. Owner: Console+SRE. Est effort: 4 sprints.
Burst-capacity preview: analytics job + UI forecast card. Owner: Platform-engineering + Product. Est effort: 3 sprints.
longer_bets: Embedding drift system: periodic sampling, drift metric (embedding centroid/variance), auto-suggest workflows for reindex. Cross-team (Applied-ML + Optimize). Est effort: 6+ sprints.
Quota-symmetric routing: routing algorithm that enforces fairness and preemption policies during shortages. Needs research + infra changes. Est effort: roadmap-level.
unresolved_questions: How tolerant are customers to increased latency in exchange for cost savings (survey needed).
Do we expose 'prefer_small_model' as an opt-in tenant-level setting or route-level override?
Embedded drift: what threshold should trigger an auto-suggest vs. auto-action? legal/regulatory implications for auto-reindexing?
Operationally, who takes on pager for embedding drift alerts—CS or SRE? Need on-call playbook.
next_steps: Share this annotary with Product-hosted-api and Observability by EOD 2026-09-21. (Aisha)
Run a 10-minute customer pulse survey focusing on latency vs cost tradeoffs; target top 30 customers. (CS Ops)
Spin up a short spike for KV cache telemetry feasibility: sample schema + cost estimate. (Eng infra lead)
Add quick-win tasks to next sprint board and tag them with 'field-signal-ship'. (Product Manager)
Schedule a cross-functional sync (CS, Product, Serving, Observability) to triage top 5 items; suggested time: 2026-09-28.
